en.headline: Yuen Kee Food clears HKEX hearing, eyes October listing
en.dek: The dumpling-chain operator is preparing to raise between HK$300 million and HK$400 million, according to people familiar with the matter, after completing three funding rounds.
body: Yuen Kee Food Group, the parent of the Yuen Kee Dumpling brand, has cleared its listing hearing with Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, sources familiar with the matter said. The company is targeting an initial public offering in October to raise between HK$300 million and HK$400 million, with the final size dependent on valuation and investor demand.

Huatai International and GF Securities are acting as joint sponsors. The group has completed three funding rounds ahead of the float, including investment from BA Capital. Proceeds are expected to support digital and intelligent construction, overseas expansion, branding and supply-chain upgrades.

As of late May the group operated 4,773 outlets worldwide, covering more than 250 mainland Chinese cities, primarily through franchised stores. The timetable and terms of the offering could still change, one source noted.

zh.headline: 袁記雲餃通過港交所聆訊 擬10月上市集資3至4億
zh.dek: 知情人士指，餃子連鎖品牌母公司已通過上市聆訊，擬於10月展開招股，集資額視乎估值及需求而定。
body: 知情人士表示，袁記雲餃品牌母公司袁記食品集團已通過港交所上市聆訊，計劃於10月進行首次公開招股，目標集資3億至4億港元，最終規模視乎估值及投資者需求。
華泰國際及廣發證券擔任聯席保薦人。集團在上市前已完成三輪融資，投資者包括BA Capital。所得款項擬用於數碼及智能化建設、海外市場拓展、品牌推廣及供應鏈升級。
截至5月底，集團在全球經營4,773間門店，覆蓋內地逾250個城市，主要以特許經營為主。一名消息人士指，招股時間表及條款仍有可能調整。
